items.title: DP World加快富吉拉两座码头约25亿迪拉姆投资开发计划
items.title_en: DP World accelerates approximately AED2.5 billion Fujairah two-terminal development programme
items.summary: DP World于11月11日披露富吉拉Al Rugaylat和Dibba两座码头的分期开发进展，长期投资计划约25亿迪拉姆，拟将投运目标由24—30个月缩短至18—24个月。Al Rugaylat规划年处理约250万TEU集装箱，Dibba规划年处理约360万吨杂货。该金额为分期投资计划，并非当天新授予施工合同。
items.summary_en: On 11 November, DP World reported accelerated development plans for the Al Rugaylat and Dibba terminals in Fujairah, with an approximately AED2.5 billion phased investment programme. The intended opening timetable was shortened from 24–30 months to 18–24 months. Al Rugaylat is designed for roughly 2.5 million TEU annually and Dibba for approximately 3.6 million tonnes of general cargo. The investment is not a newly awarded construction contract.
items.why_it_matters: 富吉拉港口开发具有物流及工程设备需求，但具体招标包必须另行核实。
items.why_it_matters_en: Fujairah port expansion may generate logistics and infrastructure equipment demand, but individual procurement packages require verification.
items.gci_opportunity: 跟进港口施工、起重及装卸设备、堆场、仓储与物流分包机会。
items.gci_opportunity_en: Track port works, cargo-handling equipment, yards, warehousing and logistics subcontracting.

items.title: Viatris与ADCAN Pharma签订阿联酋药品本地化制造合作协议
items.title_en: Viatris and ADCAN Pharma agree on local pharmaceutical manufacturing in the UAE
items.summary: 11月11日，阿联酋药品监管机构EDE与Viatris达成合作备忘录，同时Viatris与ADCAN Pharma签署选定药品的本地化制造安排，促进供应链和生产能力建设。尚未披露新工厂施工合同或总投资金额。
items.summary_en: On 11 November, the UAE's Emirates Drug Establishment and Viatris announced a cooperation MoU, while Viatris and ADCAN Pharma signed an agreement to localise manufacturing of selected medicines in the UAE. No new factory construction contract value or total capital expenditure was announced.
items.why_it_matters: 本地药品制造协议可能带来包装、物流及生产配套合作，但不等同新建工厂授标。
items.why_it_matters_en: Local pharmaceutical manufacturing may create packaging, logistics and production support opportunities; it is not a new factory construction award.
items.gci_opportunity: 关注医药包装、制造设备、供应链及跨境品牌本地化服务。
items.gci_opportunity_en: Monitor pharmaceutical packaging, equipment, supply chains and market-localisation services.

items.title: 阿曼Sultan Haitham City第17住宅片区设计咨询合同签署
items.title_en: Design consultancy awarded for Neighbourhood 17 at Oman's Sultan Haitham City
items.summary: 11月11日，Retal Urban Development授予F&M建筑与工程设计公司Sultan Haitham City第17住宅片区的首席设计顾问及备案建筑师服务合同。该片区涵盖单户和多户住宅及社区规划，属于既有城市开发项目的新设计服务合同，不是施工总包授标。
items.summary_en: On 11 November, Retal Urban Development awarded F&M the lead design consultancy and Architect of Record contract for Neighbourhood 17 at Sultan Haitham City. The planned district includes single-family and multi-family housing and associated urban design. This is a new design services award within an established master development, not a construction EPC contract.
items.why_it_matters: 新设计合同可以作为提前接触建筑材料与承包商的切入线索，采购仍在后续阶段。
items.why_it_matters_en: The design award is an early lead for contractors and materials suppliers, with construction procurement still to follow.
items.gci_opportunity: 跟进住宅土建、机电、建材、精装修与设计方合作。
items.gci_opportunity_en: Track residential civil works, MEP, building materials, fit-out and design partnerships.

items.title: 阿曼苏哈尔港推进日处理约1吨液氢的液化与海运示范合作
items.title_en: Oman's Sohar Port explores liquid hydrogen liquefaction and maritime logistics pilot
items.summary: 11月11日披露，HYTRA、Path2 Hydrogen和GenH2正研究在阿曼苏哈尔港实施液氢液化与运输示范项目，拟采用日处理约1吨氢的液化系统，并评估低温储存、装卸及海运应用。当前为试点合作研究，尚无最终投资决定或工程授标。
items.summary_en: A report on 11 November outlined a proposed liquid hydrogen pilot at Sohar Port involving HYTRA, Path2 Hydrogen and GenH2, potentially using a liquefaction system processing approximately one tonne of hydrogen per day while evaluating cryogenic storage, handling and maritime logistics. The concept remains under study, with no final investment decision or EPC award.
items.why_it_matters: 港口液氢试点有技术供应潜力，但商业化和工程采购仍待确认。
items.why_it_matters_en: The liquid-hydrogen pilot may offer specialist technology opportunities, but commercial deployment and procurement remain unconfirmed.
items.gci_opportunity: 关注低温储存设备、特种管线、氢能设备及港口技术合作。
items.gci_opportunity_en: Monitor cryogenic storage, specialty piping, hydrogen equipment and port technology partnerships.

items.title: 利比里亚发布142kWp太阳能系统供货安装调试招标
items.title_en: Liberia tenders supply, installation and commissioning of a 142 kWp solar power system
items.summary: 非洲开发银行融资的利比里亚气候信息系统韧性发展（CIS）项目于11月11日发布142kWp太阳能电力系统的供应、交付、安装和调试采购公告。项目具有明确系统规模；投标资格、截止日期及技术清单以原始招标文件为准。
items.summary_en: On 11 November, Liberia's African Development Bank-financed Enhancing Climate Information System for Resilience Development (CIS) project issued a specific procurement notice for supply, delivery, installation and commissioning of a 142 kWp solar power system. The system capacity is defined; eligibility, submission deadline and technical specifications are subject to the bidding documents.
items.why_it_matters: 明确的设备加安装采购，适合具有当地交付能力的光伏及电气供应商。
items.why_it_matters_en: A concrete equipment-and-installation procurement opportunity suited to qualified PV and electrical suppliers with local delivery capabilities.
items.gci_opportunity: 关注中国光伏组件、逆变器、储能、安装及项目交付伙伴。
items.gci_opportunity_en: Monitor Chinese PV modules, inverters, storage, installation and delivery partners.

items.title: 利比里亚Roberts机场国家气象中心建筑翻新工程招标
items.title_en: Liberia tenders national meteorological centre renovation at Roberts airport
items.summary: 利比里亚CIS项目于11月11日发布Roberts International Airport内国家气象中心MET建筑的屋面、室内及外立面翻修施工采购。项目为现有建筑改造，具体报价、资格和期限以公告附件为准。
items.summary_en: On 11 November, Liberia's CIS programme published a tender for roofing, interior and exterior renovation works at the National Meteorological Center's MET Building at Roberts International Airport. It concerns refurbishment of an existing building, with eligibility, scope and submission dates governed by the tender documents.
items.why_it_matters: 已发布具体建筑翻修采购包，但不是机场扩建新工程。
items.why_it_matters_en: A defined building-refurbishment tender, not an airport expansion contract.
items.gci_opportunity: 关注建筑装修、屋面防水、机电及材料供货施工。
items.gci_opportunity_en: Monitor renovation, roofing and waterproofing, MEP and construction materials.

items.title: 加纳技术技能培训中心设备供货交付及安装采购
items.title_en: Ghana tenders supply, delivery and installation of equipment for technical skills training centres
items.summary: 非洲开发基金支持的加纳PSDPEP计划于11月11日发布SIF项目技术技能培训中心设备供货、交付及安装招标。采购属于职业技术教育装备供应，设备类别、数量、标段与投标截止日应以正式文件核实。
items.summary_en: On 11 November, Ghana's African Development Fund-backed PSDPEP programme issued a specific procurement notice for supply, delivery and installation of equipment for technical skills training centres under SIF. The equipment categories, quantities, lots and bid deadlines require confirmation in the official tender package.
items.why_it_matters: 真实职业培训设备采购项目，适合符合规范的工业实训与ICT供应商。
items.why_it_matters_en: An actual technical-training equipment procurement opportunity for qualified industrial training and ICT suppliers.
items.gci_opportunity: 跟进工业实训设备、机械及电子设备、出口代理和当地安装合作。
items.gci_opportunity_en: Track technical training systems, mechanical and electronic equipment, export distribution and local installation.

items.title: 利比里亚发布水文气象监测网络设备采购
items.title_en: Liberia tenders hydrometeorological observation network equipment
items.summary: 非洲开发银行融资的利比里亚CIS项目11月11日发布水文与气象观测网络增强设备的供货采购公告。该标段与同项目142kWp太阳能及MET建筑翻修不同，属于独立的监测设备采购合同，具体规格与交付要求以原始招标资料为准。
items.summary_en: On 11 November, Liberia's African Development Bank-funded CIS programme issued a procurement notice for equipment to enhance hydrometeorological observation networks. This is a separate monitoring-equipment procurement package from the 142 kWp solar installation and MET building refurbishment notices under the same programme. Specifications and delivery requirements follow the tender documents.
items.why_it_matters: 采购项目与05、06同属一个融资计划，但为不同标段，不应重复计为三个投资计划。
items.why_it_matters_en: The equipment package is separate from items 05 and 06 within the same financing programme; the three notices must not be counted as three unrelated investments.
items.gci_opportunity: 关注监测传感器、气象站、数据采集、系统集成与技术服务。
items.gci_opportunity_en: Monitor sensors, weather stations, data acquisition, systems integration and technical services.
